facts.fact: The study states that the National Automated Civil Status Register connects all municipalities, their administrative annexes and consular offices abroad, and that civil status documents are issued from any municipality whatever the citizen's place of birth or residence; it gives no date for this, so the publication date is used.

The study says the National Automated Civil Status Register connects 'all municipalities' and their annexes, with no count of municipalities, no denominator and no source for the statement; undated, so the publication date is used.

The study states that the National Automated Civil Status Register, which links the municipalities, was established under Law 14-08 of 9 August 2014 and is supervised by the Ministry of the Interior and Local Assemblies; the supervision is stated as current at publication, the date used.

note: The study also finds, undated and without figures, that the e-municipality is held back by an incomplete rollout of high-speed internet infrastructure; no aspect value fits it.
